messages.subject: INLA to calculate poor people counts
parts:
Hello everyone,
      I  want to do spatial-temporal modeling of areal poverty ratio data using INLA. The  poverty ratio  represent the ratio of poverty household in all households in a village, collected from 300 villages in a county annualy  from 2013-2017, the value ranged from 0-1. I want to build spatial-temporal model of poverty ratio using some variables. In general,  poverty ratio seems to follow gaussian distribution from 2013-2017, data like this :


 I write a model like this:

formula.st<- y ~ 1  + X1 + X2 + X3+ X4 + X5 + X6 + f(ID.area,model="bym",graph=yy.adj) +
  f(ID.year,model="rw1") + f(ID.year1,model="iid")
model.inla.st <- inla(formula.st,family="gaussian",data=data, control.family = list(hyper = list(prec = list(prior = "loggamma",param = c(1.0,0.01),initial = 2))),scale=scale, keep=TRUE)


but the result seems to be wrong , many are null value. I just started to learn INLA and dont know what's wrong with this, Can anybody help me with this? Thank you very much!
